summary: 22-year-old Boulder man reported missing ~9 p.m. Monday after not returning from a day of skiing at Eldora Mountain Resort; vehicle found in the ski-area parking lot; resort employees searching the slopes found his body just off the Jolly Jug run; preliminary investigation: fell while skiing and collided with a tree; BCSO and coroner on scene, no foul play
location: Jolly Jug run, Eldora Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder County Coroner's Office; Eldora Mountain Resort employees
